summary: Frontend-only testing of CR-047 mock design: vendor field layout, payment split side-by-side, auto-batch uniqueness, and balance indicator.

test_results.vendor_field_compact: PASS - Vendor, Purchase Date, and Fare all visible in same header row without wrapping
test_results.single_payment_leg: PASS - Single payment leg shows Cash mode + amount in one row (grid-template-columns: 1fr)
test_results.two_payment_legs_side_by_side: PASS - After clicking +Split: paymentSection style sets grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; Row 0 at x=1264, Row 1 at x=1581, same y=121 (side-by-side confirmed)
test_results.auto_batch_uniqueness: PASS - autoBatch('American Corn', 0) = 'AME-OCT-18'; autoBatch('American Corn', 1) with rows[0].batch set = 'AME-OCT-18-2'; unique=true, suffix_correct=true
test_results.balance_indicator: PASS - Balance indicator '₹0.00 / ₹0.00 — Balanced ✓' appears below payment legs after split
